text: A Super-Agent-Based Framework for Reputation Management introduces a reward mechanism to induce super-agents to contribute resources, maintain reputation, form communities, and provide truthful reputation information. This independently agrees with Kaal's mechanism linking reputational governance incentives to mutually beneficial community participation. The abstract does not establish incentive compatibility against collusion or false reporting.
